operations.name: transactions.list
operations.summary:
Complete transaction search (read-only):
  whab "My budget" trnx list --since 2026-08-01 --merchant "Fictional Village" --format table
  whab "My budget" trnx list --since 2026-08-01 --until 2026-08-31 --merchant "Fictional Mortgage"
  whab "My budget" trnx list --merchant "Fictional Village" --merchant "Fictional Mortgage"

Default: all available nondeleted history, all accounts/currencies, reviewed and
unreviewed, categorized and uncategorized, pending/posted, transfers and refunds.
--since and --until are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds; either can be omitted.
--merchant matches a case-insensitive literal substring of the merchant only.
Repeat it for OR (ANY supplied text). Spaces/emoji/non-Latin text are supported;
quote spaces. No fuzzy, regex, wildcard, synonym or lender inference. Different
mortgage lenders are not aliases. Without --merchant, all merchants match.
--month YYYY-MM optionally restricts the initial public read and intersects bounds.

Results: budgetId/revision, filters, total/returned, complete=true and every matching
public transaction, newest date first with stable ID tie-breaker (no intraday time).
Rows retain IDs, dates, account IDs/names, merchants, integer minor-unit amounts,
currencies, category IDs/names/groups, notes, agent labels and pending/review status.
Tables show stable IDs in full, separate currency and review/status columns; names
may be shortened. JSON is authoritative. Positive amounts are outflows, negative
amounts are inflows/refunds. Never combine currencies.

Completeness: no default limit or hidden pagination. Every successful read returns
all matches (total=returned=len(data), complete=true). Each public response is
bounded to 16 MiB; oversized, failed or inconsistent budget/revision reads fail
without partial output. Current hosts filter dates and merchants in one coherent storage read; older hosts retain public-query filtering.
Use --month and inspect each month separately when complete output exceeds the response limit.
Rerun a read after a concurrent change; do not treat a stale revision as write consent.

Next: inspect ALL matches and categories before deciding:
  whab "My budget" trnx categories
  whab "My budget" trnx categorize TRANSACTION_ID --category "Housing / Fictional home" --agent Codex
Rerun the identical list after edits; compare stable ID sets/counts and category IDs.
Categorize is a separate guarded edit; review is preserved unless --needs-review.
Retain original arguments/revision/request ID after an uncertain write, inspect the
saved result, and never automatically replay a new intent. This list never edits,
reviews, syncs or creates a persistent future categorization rule. Help is offline.

items.description: Nonblank literal merchant substring.

items.description: One literal merchant substring.

operations.name: category.workflow
operations.summary:
Category workflow (fictional budget; no wizard):
  whab "My budget" category list --format table
  whab "My budget" category group create "Projects"
  whab "My budget" category move "Finance / Example studio" --parent "Projects"
  whab "My budget" category create "Example venture" --parent "Projects"
  whab "My budget" category list --parent "Projects" --format table
  whab "My budget" category delete --help
  whab "My budget" category group delete --help
  whab "My budget" history list

Read the hierarchy, confirm the intended parent and child with the user, apply one
confirmed choice, then inspect the verified result before continuing. All commands
address the budget by its existing unique name or stable ID. Groups accept an exact
unique name or stable ID; children also accept "Group / Name". Names ignore case
and outer whitespace; spaces, emoji and non-Latin text work when quoted. No fuzzy
match is selected. Missing/ambiguous names show candidate names and IDs.

Groups are real nonassignable parents and may be empty. Only children can receive
transactions, targets or monthly assignments; deeper nesting is refused. Child
creation requires an existing --parent, defaults to --currency USD and --target 0,
and refuses duplicate sibling names. Target is a nonnegative integer in currency
minor units (USD 1234 = $12.34). No currency conversion is performed. Moves preserve
child identity, currency, targets, transaction references, every month's assignments
and prior history. Unrelated children and the original parent remain intact, even
when the original parent becomes empty. Existing ledger order is preserved on move;
there is currently no manual reorder operation or requested-order guarantee.

JSON is the default and retains full IDs/fields; --format table is for readable
inspection. Successful writes report the addressed budget and verified saved group
or child. Revisions and unique request IDs are handled internally. Each command is
one atomic change; the sequence is not one transaction. Stale state is refused.
No bank synchronization is started. After an uncertain response, inspect category
list and history and retain the complete reported original intent (budget, payload,
revision and request ID). Never automatically rerun a write with a new intent.

Help works offline without a profile or running host. The category management
commands require WHAB 2.65+; saving empty groups and moving children require native
SQLite 1.18+, JSON 1.10+ or another adapter implementing CategoryManagement. Older
storage can still provide derived nonempty groups for reads; unsupported writes
fail explicitly. Use whab BUDGET category ACTION --help for each command.

Safe deletion (CLI 2.15+, WHAB 2.69+, SQLite 1.21+/JSON 1.13+):
  whab "My budget" category show "Fictional maintenance / Example home" --format table
  whab "My budget" category delete "Fictional maintenance / Example home"
  whab "My budget" category list --parent "Fictional maintenance"
  whab "My budget" category group delete "Fictional maintenance"
  whab "My budget" category list --format table
  whab "My budget" history list

Read category show, confirm the intended child, then issue one guarded delete.
Children require NO transaction references, including live, pending, reviewed,
refund and deleted records, and NO nonzero monthly assignments in any month.
Zero-only assignment rows do NOT block deletion: the operation removes them and
that unused child atomically. Any nonzero row or transaction refuses the ENTIRE
operation; no zero rows are removed on refusal. All unrelated rows and financial
fields, monthly monetary results and rollover settings remain unchanged.
Deleting a child retains its empty parent; groups must have NO children. Delete
an empty parent with the separate group command. There is no cascade or --force.

category show accepts exact names/IDs or child "Group / Name", never fuzzy matches.
JSON is complete; --format table is readable. deletion.deletable is true when only
zero rows remain and no transactions refer to the child. assignments.count/months
include EVERY row; zeroMonths lists rows deletion will remove; nonzeroCount and
nonzeroMonths identify blocking rows. No amounts or unrelated transactions are
exposed. Show is read-only and never changes revision/history, syncs, or authorizes
a later write. A concurrent revision change refuses a mixed inspection result.

Each successful delete commits permanent audit history, category metadata and
EXACT removed zero rows together, including zero-valued rows in every month.
Use history list/show to inspect it. Guarded undo/redo previews restore/reapply
category identity, target, parent relationship and every zero row when compatible.
Later conflicting changes refuse the whole reversal. Prior audit entries/hashes
are preserved. Success reports deleted=true and a verified same-revision hierarchy
with all other groups/children unchanged. Request IDs/revisions are internal.

HTTP 400 domain refusals and HTTP 409 stale/conflicting intents report the actual
reason; no automatic retry. Timeouts, HTTP 5xx or failed verification remain
uncertain, not proof of rollback. Inspect category list and history; retain the
COMPLETE original budget/payload/revision/request ID. Never rerun deletion with a
new request ID to retry. No bank synchronization is started. No nonzero funding,
transaction or unrelated assignment is erased. This is not category merge/archive.
Older adapters may conservatively refuse zero rows; update to the required versions
for this policy. Help and packaged operation documentation work offline.

Rename in place: whab "My budget" category rename "House / Rent" --name "Main Residence" --agent Codex --batch housing-cleanup
Preserves ID, parent, currency, target, references, assignments and history. Rejects ambiguous names and duplicate siblings. Revisions/request IDs are automatic; recovery retains the original intent.

Explicit Income/Expense categories: category create --type income or category classify CATEGORY --type income --dry-run. Preview impacts, then repeat without --dry-run. Income has target zero and no monthly assignment rows. A parent can mix Income Salary and Expense Fees. Review is independent. No legacy transaction is relabeled; classifiedIncome/unclassifiedIncome separate contributions without changing old totals. See category classify --help for full safety/recovery/examples.
